story_title: SPM-94: As the Event Organiser who raised a request, I want its approval or rejection outcome and the reason to be seen only by the people involved in it so that my request is not exposed to staff who have no part in the event.

acceptance_criteria.text: The rejection reason is shown only to the Event Organiser responsible for the event, the Event Coordinator assigned to it, and the Event Coordinator Lead.

Venue Staff, Technical Support Staff and the Safety Officer cannot open an event request that has not been approved (Submitted, Under review, Rejected or Withdrawn), and such requests do not appear in any list they can see. They see an event from Approved onwards, when their part of the work can begin.
Event Coordinators not assigned to the event can see its status but not the rejection reason.
Other Event Organisers in the same client organisation can see the event's status, as today, but not the rejection reason.
Given a user may not see an event, when they open it directly, then they see the same "not found" state as for an event that does not exist, so the request's existence and outcome are not revealed.
The same rules apply to the information the system returns, not only to what the screens show.
Attendees continue to see only Confirmed events open for registration, and never an outcome or reason.

open_questions: DECIDED 2026-10-26 (by us; customer not yet asked again): 'relevant authorised internal users' (#125) means the assigned Event Coordinator and the Event Coordinator Lead for the outcome and reason; Venue Staff, Technical Support Staff and the Safety Officer see events from Approved onwards. Consistent with #66 (staff see what their responsibilities need), #81 (same-client organisers may view) and #136 (the Lead views active events' status). Recorded in docs/CUSTOMER_CLARIFICATIONS.md; if the customer rules otherwise, that wins.

DECIDED 2026-10-23: 'From Approved onwards' means Approved, Planning, Safety review, Safety approved, Confirmed, Postponed, Completed and Cancelled. Cancelled is reachable only after approval, so a cancelled event stays visible to Venue Staff, Technical Support and the Safety Officer.

DECIDED 2026-10-23: The not-found state is the one the event page already shows for an event that does not exist: heading 'Event', error box 'Could not load this' with 'This event doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.' and 'Retry'. The event's other pages use the same message; the Equipment page today says 'Could not load this event.' for a hidden event and is to use the same wording (TC08).

DECIDED 2026-10-23: The lists that hold events for Venue Staff, Technical Support and the Safety Officer are the Dashboard, All Events (/events: in the sidebar for the Safety Officer, reachable by address for the other two) and Safety Checks. Booking Requests and Equipment Requests list only events with arrangements, which cannot exist before approval, so no case is written for them.

DECIDED 2026-10-23: AC6 (the information the system returns) is checked by the automated route tests: the event list and the event record leave out the rejection reason for an unassigned coordinator and a colleague organiser, and Venue Staff, Technical Support and the Safety Officer get not found for an unapproved event, on the event and every route under it. TC04-TC08 link AC6 because the event page shows the rejection box whenever the record it receives carries a reason.
DECIDED 2026-10-23: The event's status history keeps the reason in its own column. It is not shown or returned anywhere today, and stays that way.

DECIDED 2026-10-23: SPM-31-TC02 ('internal staff view any non-draft event') is marked Updated with a v2 note in this story's PR (docs/test-cases/DECOMMISSIONED.md). Its event is in Planning, so it still passes.
RESOLVED 2026-10-23: Notifying the outcome belongs to SPM-53 (AC4 reworded for #125), not this story. No case here.
